remarks: Downtown Stamford convenience with a quiet neighborhood feel.  This renovated 2 bedroom 1.5 bath townhouse has the feel of a home. Walking distance to the new Whole Foods, Ridgeway and plenty of shops and restaurants with easy access to downtown Stamford. Nicely renovated with hardwood floors, freshly painted and ready to move in. The first floor features an open layout with a private office. The lower level is perfect for storage or a gym. Outside features a private patio and space for a grill. The owner takes care of all exterior maintenance. Central a/c, washer & dryer in the unit, recessed LED lights, 1 reserved space plus ample street parking. This unit is also available furnished with flexible lease options for $4,999 per month. Ask about pets
